text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health both physically and mentally with good academic background, observe Chinese laws as well as university rules and regulations, and respect Chinese customs. 2. Language proficiency requirements: ● English-taught programs: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 80, Duolingo 90 or equivalent 3. Academic and Age Requirements: Completed high school, and be under 26 years old
